text:
mira: Quick triage note — onboarding canary for zephyr-v1 q4f (int8) shows localized regressions for CJK/AR when hair/zero-width joiner characters present.

mira: Short stats from the canary run:
- ja BLEU: 21.9 (-3.2 vs fp32)
- zh BLEU: 28.9 (-0.6)
- ar BLEU: 17.2 (-4.4)

mira: Pattern: token substitutions or detokenization glitches when inputs include U+200A/U+200D adjacent to punctuation or ligature sequences. E.g.:
Input JP: "お待ちください " -> Output int8: extra space or missing joiner.
Input AR: "(بال‍ال)" -> Output int8: bracket mirror flipped or ligature split.

devon: Noted. We added a compact remap table for special whitespace/zwj folding in q4f to shrink the vocab footprint. If remap misapplied on runtime decode path it could shift indices for neighboring tokens.

eva: Can you attach 6 minimal repros (input, token ids fp32 vs int8, model output) so I can add to the harness?

mira: Uploaded a small bundle to S3: s3://redwood-evals/zephyr/q4f-hairspace-repro-1766004321.tar.gz — includes token id traces and raw logits for suspect spans.

kai: @eval-bot run compare: zephyr-v1 fp32 vs q4f on the hairspace subset and post token diffs.

eval-bot: Compare started: compare-1766004321. Link: https://ci.redwood/zephyr/compare/1766004321

devon: Quick triage steps I recommend: 1) run q4f artifact with remap_passthrough=true, 2) run q4f with kernel=fp32-emulate to rule out packing numeric error, 3) inspect KVC packing offsets for off-by-one.

mira: Running remap_passthrough and fp32-emulate now, will post results in ~30m.

eva: If remap_passthrough fixes it, we should disable whitespace folding for the canary and add a unit test for hair/zwj preservation. I'll add a gate in the harness to fail canary if hair/ZWJ substitution rate > 1%.

eval-bot: Compare finished: summary: JA -3.1, AR -4.3; flagged 71/90 hair/ZWJ anomalies. Token diffs uploaded. Link: https://ci.redwood/zephyr/compare/1766004321/results

mira: Thanks. Action items:
- mira: post remap_passthrough + fp32-emulate traces (ETA 30m)
- devon: audit remap folding rules + KVC packing for index offsets (ETA EOD)
- eva: add hair/ZWJ test and canary gate (ETA EOD)

kai: Good plan. Keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
